ideas.pitch: An AI-powered real-time journey monitoring application that analyzes pedestrian and transit paths for safety risks, offering dynamic rerouting and automated emergency alerts.
ideas.problem_statement: Special Winner — Women Safety: In addition to the four main tracks, HERHACK 2026 will recognize top solutions focusing on women safety.
ideas.title: SafeRoute AI: Women Safety Transit Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the special women safety recognition prize at a women-focused national hackathon, ensuring high judge resonance.

ideas.pitch: A Web3-based verifiable credential exchange platform that enables individuals to securely own, share, and revoke personal data permissions without central intermediaries.
ideas.problem_statement: WEB3 / BLOCKCHAIN: Build decentralized and trust-driven solutions using blockchain, smart contracts, Web3 infrastructure, decentralized identity, digital assets, and related technologies.
ideas.title: TrustVerify: Decentralized Credential & Consent Ledger
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes decentralized identity primitives (DID) which heavily appeal to the Web3 track judges looking for core blockchain utility beyond basic tokens.

ideas.pitch: An IoT-enabled sensor network and edge dashboard that monitors indoor air quality, noise levels, and emergency distress signals across campus facilities.
ideas.problem_statement: INTERNET OF THINGS (IoT): Build connected hardware and software solutions involving sensors, embedded systems, automation, edge computing, smart environments, and IoT platforms.
ideas.title: AuraGuard IoT: Smart Campus Environment Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical sensor data with a real-time cloud dashboard, matching the specific requirements of the IoT track.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multi-agent student support and mentorship platform that matches student developers with targeted learning paths and career milestones.
ideas.problem_statement: STUDENT INNOVATION: Build innovative technology solutions addressing meaningful real-world problems. This is a broad track for ideas that do not naturally fit into the other three technical tracks.
ideas.title: SkillBridge AI: Multi-Agent Mentorship and Career Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages multi-agent orchestration frameworks to provide deeply personalized outputs, following proven winning patterns in AI platforms.

ideas.pitch: An automated compliance risk detection tool that analyzes transaction graph structures and flags suspicious financial movements with explainable AI summaries.
ideas.problem_statement: WEB3 / BLOCKCHAIN: Build decentralized and trust-driven solutions using blockchain, smart contracts, Web3 infrastructure, decentralized identity, digital assets, and related technologies.
ideas.title: AuditShield: AI-Driven AML & Risk Investigation Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous graph intelligence and explainable machine learning models into financial and Web3 tracking, standing out for its technical depth.
